svg.title: Figure 17 · Block resampling of realized strategy returns
svg.desc: 600 circular moving-block resamples of the fixed strategy’s net return series, block length 20, NumPy seed 5107. This resamples returns without rerunning signals or refitting parameters; it is a conditional path diagnostic, not a complete strategy-research uncertainty analysis.
